text: Centipede-infested monks encountered at Senpu Temple move with unnatural, insectile motions and sometimes have visible centipedes protruding from their bodies.
There are two distinct Great Serpents in Ashina, both once ordinary animals transformed over centuries by the rejuvenating waters into enormous, ancient beings.
The Great Serpents react to Wolf with hostility as if sensing that the dragon's heritage in his blood is related to the power within them.
The Okami Warriors are tall, fierce women who guard the Fountain Head Palace, fighting with lightning-infused weapons and retaining more martial vigor than the Palace Nobles.
